implementation: Vormetric Encryption Expert Kernel-Space Cryptographic Library
description: The Vormetric Encryption Expert Kernel-Space Cryptographic Library is one of two libraries that comprise the Vormetric Encryption Expert Cryptographic Module version 4.4.1. That module is a subset of the Vormetric Encryption Export Agent, which in turn is part of the Vormetric Data Security solution.
